page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal references ("ib.", "22.1", "Non obf.") run down the right side beside the lines. Running head at top; page number at the foot right.

main_text.p: Observ. 47 Puniatur homo pro damno quod alteri obvenerit de effossione foveæ ib. 33
Observ. 48 Puniatur homo cujus jumen tum alicui faciat damnum. ib. 35
Non 49 Fur puniendus vel [s]olvendo pecuniam, vel morte. 22.1 obs.
Observ. 50 De reponendo, si quis depascens agrum alterius, immiserit que pecus suum. ib. 5
Observ. 51 De rependendo, si quid damni ex igne contingat. ib. 6
Observ. 52 De depósito & de pastione grata. ib. 7
Observ. 53 De depósito per mercedem, vel propter mercedem. ib. 7
Observ. 54 De jure quod debet observari inter accusantem & negantem. ib. 9
Observ. 55 De mutuo bestiæ vel vesti-menti. ibi. 14
Observ. 56 Si quis pellexerit ancillam de-bet quinquaginta siclis puniri. ib. 16, 17
Non 57 Præstigiatricem ne finito vive-re. 22.18 obs.
Observ. 58 Ne injuriam facias Profylitæ justo qui accessit religionis ergo in verbis, i.e. ne fallas, vel decipias. ib. 21
Observ. 59 In emendo vel vendendo ne ta-lem circumvenias. ib. 21

page.notes: Some marginal references are abbreviated and partly illegible; the page signature "Ff 3" and folio "60" appear at the foot. Hebrew and Latin words in lines 56–58 are uncertain (e.g. "Profylitæ" may be "Proselytæ").
